main: Each active medium-scale red display pixel was exported as an EPSG:4326 polygon feature.
The active layer is the current-AOI VIIRS weak-label learned mask.
supporting: AOT-only candidates are retained in the audit as rejected candidates.
The GeoJSON export makes screenshot pixels traceable to grid cells and AOI coordinates.
conflicting: This is weak-label VIIRS inference, not Element84 public weights.
This is not Dust-Mamba, MODIS 3D-CNN, or Sentinel-2 model inference.
precursor: Meteorological precursor remains separate NASA POWER point evidence.

provenance.data_source: VIIRS NOAA-20 Corrected Reflectance; VIIRS NOAA-20 Deep Blue AOT; VIIRS NOAA-20 Aerosol Type Deep Blue; weak labels from VIIRS Deep Blue AERDB_L2 native footprints
limitations: current-AOI weak-label model, not public Element84 weights

display_policy: Use this GeoJSON as the traceable pixel-level display mask for screenshots and audit. Preserve the weak-label inference label when active.
